milestone: Registry-owned native E4M3FN/UE8M0 block32 FP16 decoding
status: Qualified numerical primitive; whole inference and vLLM parity objective remains active

implementation.registry: Explicit block-scaled decode profile, block32x32, byte weights and byte scales. Ordinary GGUF load, CPU matvec/matmul, BF16 linear and GPU execution capabilities remain disabled.
implementation.conversion: Finite E4M3FN times 2^(scale_byte-127), retaining original FP32-product then FP16 RN-even results. Integer-only conversion preserves signed zero, subnormals and overflow without host FP environment dependence.
implementation.regions: No allocation. Row-major matrix rectangle to contiguous FP16 bits; exact input byte sizes, checked capacity/geometry/address overlap; all requested source bytes checked before writes.
implementation.invalid_sources: E4M3FN NaN codes 127/255 and UE8M0 byte255 reject before output writes. Invalid bytes outside requested rectangle are not scanned.
implementation.partial_blocks: Ceil-divided block32 grid; validated using unchanged upstream routine on padded complete grids and then cropped. Upstream direct routine itself asserts divisible grid geometry.
implementation.model_integration: Native anatomy records core_format and derives scale-grid geometry from registered metadata. No GPU handles attached to CPU weights.

partial_edge_reference.scope: Original routine on zero-padded full 32x32 blocks, cropped to wire geometry; this explicitly tests partial-edge extension beyond upstream divisibility assertion.

validation.coverage: Whole matrices cover attention Q_A/Q_B/KV/O_A/O_B, shared gate/up/down, index query, and Engram projection. Raw native index reads also match frozen source bytes.
validation.atomic_rejection: Bad geometry, sizes, capacity, overlap, late NaN weights and late invalid scale leave output unchanged.

reference.method: Original dequant_e8m0_blocks_ method body extracted unchanged with AST and run on designated GPU. Captures frozen before decoder code was written.
reference.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition

limitations: This is FP16 weight materialization, not a matrix multiplication or full native model executor.
No new GPU FP8 kernel was added; no GPU FP8 compute-sanitizer claim. Complete existing CUDA suite passed.
Explicit scalar/AVX builds qualify the decoder, not every engine backend path. ARM NEON and WASM execution remain unverified.
No inference throughput, cold-storage footprint or vLLM parity claim.
